title: Captions from the approved script
statement: Make captions in code from the approved script and the clip's measured length, never by hand, and fail any video that gates progress if it has no captions.
detail: In the reading project's course, captions are never hand-written: a script derives each caption track from the signed-off transcript and the clip's duration as measured by ffprobe (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0194-g3-book-audio-clip-conventions.qmd`). Its contract validator fails a unit video with no caption track, because that video gates the way into the first lesson and captions are the only way through for a child who cannot hear (the same file).

evidence.quote: captions are NEVER hand-written. `scripts/generate-video-captions.mjs` derives a WebVTT track from the authored `transcript[]`

plus the clip's real measured duration via `ffprobe`, written next to the clip and pointed at by `captions_path`. `validate-contracts.mjs` fails a unit video with no caption track, because a unit video gates the hero pick, which gates lesson one — captions are the only way through for a child who cannot hear, not an accessibility nicety.
